findings.detail: PP03 issue rows are sourced from the December 31, 2025 comparative investment schedule while the reviewed holdings surface is report_date 2026-03-31.

rationale: Class 2 within-row period purity issue. The bundle identifies six PP03 rows whose source period is earlier than the 2026-03-31 report_date. Raw source confirms the same issuers appear in both the March 31, 2026 investment schedule and the December 31, 2025 comparative schedule; for example, 77 Commercial appears in table 15 row 6 for the current schedule and table 21 row 3 for the comparative schedule, and COLT 2025-INV2 B2 appears in table 17 row 12 and table 23 row 9. Retaining the comparative-period rows under the current report-date holdings surface is a real comparative-period leakage defect. No aggregate anchor was needed because the source row coordinates localize the defect.
